passport.name: Passport
passport.eligibility: Any Indian citizen. Minors apply with a parent's consent (Annexure D).
docs: Proof of address: Aadhaar, electricity/water bill, bank passbook or rent agreement
Proof of date of birth: birth certificate, PAN, Aadhaar or Class 10 marksheet
Old passport, if you are applying for re-issue
Original documents plus one self-attested photocopy of each

steps.d: Create a free account on the Passport Seva portal or the mPassport Seva app. Choose your nearest Regional Passport Office.
Pick ‘Apply for Fresh Passport’ or ‘Re-issue’. Fill personal, family and address details. Check spelling against your Aadhaar.

steps.t: Pay the fee and book a slot
steps.d: Pay online (card, UPI or net banking) and book an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office PSK. Print or save the appointment receipt.
Reach 15 minutes early. You pass three counters: document check and photo + fingerprints (A), verification (B), and approval (C). Your photo is taken there.
A police officer visits your address or calls you to the station to verify identity and address. Keep your documents handy. Track it in the mPassport Police app.
Once police clear the report, the passport is printed and sent by Speed Post. Track the status online with your file number.
Sign for the passport at your door. Check name, date of birth and photo. Report mistakes to the RPO immediately.

tips: Tatkal skips the queue but needs extra documents.
Use the same name spelling on every document.
Book slots early in the morning when new ones open.

learner-licence.name: Learner's Licence
learner-licence.issuer: Ministry of Road Transport (Sarathi / your RTO)
learner-licence.eligibility: 16+ for gearless two-wheelers up to 50cc; 18+ for cars and geared bikes.
docs: Medical certificate Form 1A if you are above 40

steps.t: Open Sarathi and choose your state
steps.d: Go to Sarathi Parivahan → Online Services → Driving Licence Related Services → select your state.
Pick ‘Apply for Learner Licence’. Choose Aadhaar-based authentication to give the test from home (where your state allows it).

steps.t: Fill the form and upload documents
steps.d: Enter details, choose vehicle classes (MCWG for bike, LMV for car), upload photo, signature and documents.
Pay online. Save the receipt and application number.
A short road-signs and traffic-rules quiz on your phone or laptop with the camera on. Most states need about 60% to pass.
Download the PDF immediately after passing. It is valid for 6 months. Practise with an ‘L’ sign and a licensed driver beside you.

tips: You can apply for your permanent DL 30 days after getting the LL.
Practise the sample test on Sarathi before the real one.

driving-licence.name: Driving Licence
driving-licence.issuer: Ministry of Road Transport (Sarathi / your RTO)
driving-licence.eligibility: Must hold a Learner's Licence for at least 30 days. 18+ for cars.
docs: Proof of age and address (Aadhaar works for both)
Vehicle for the test (bring your own in most RTOs)

steps.d: Practise driving during this time. The LL must still be valid when you take the test.

steps.t: Apply for Driving Licence on Sarathi
steps.d: Online Services → Driving Licence → your state → ‘Apply for Driving Licence’. Enter your LL number and date of birth.
Upload photo and proofs, then pay the licence and test fee online.
Pick a date and time at your RTO or an accredited driving test centre.
Carry your LL, receipt and originals. The inspector checks control, turns, reverse, parking and traffic signs. Two-wheeler tests often include an ‘8’ track.
After you pass, the smart card is printed and sent by Speed Post. Download the digital copy on DigiLocker or mParivahan meanwhile; it is legally valid.

tips: If you fail, you can retake the test after 7 days.
Keep your DL in DigiLocker; traffic police accept it.

aadhaar.name: Aadhaar Card
aadhaar.eligibility: Any resident of India, including newborns (Baal Aadhaar).
docs: Proof of identity: PAN, passport, voter ID, ration card or school ID
Proof of address: bank passbook, utility bill, ration card
For children: birth certificate and a parent's Aadhaar

steps.d: Use ‘Locate an Enrolment Centre’ on the UIDAI site. Banks, post offices and Aadhaar Seva Kendras enrol people.
Book a slot online at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to avoid long queues. Walk-ins are also accepted.
Get the form at the centre or download it. Fill name, address, date of birth and mobile number.
The operator takes your photo, all 10 fingerprints and an iris scan, and scans your documents.
The slip has a 14-digit Enrolment ID (EID) with date and time. You need it to check status.
Once generated, download e-Aadhaar from myAadhaar with your EID or mobile OTP. It is as valid as the printed letter. The letter also comes by post.

tips: New enrolment is free. Don't pay anyone for it.
Order a PVC Aadhaar card online for ₹50 if you want a wallet card.
Link a working mobile number; most updates need OTP.

pan.name: PAN Card
pan.eligibility: Anyone who earns, pays tax, opens a bank account or invests. Minors through a parent.
docs: Aadhaar linked to your mobile (for instant e-PAN)
For physical PAN: proof of identity, address and date of birth

steps.d: On the Income Tax e-filing portal, open ‘Instant e-PAN’ → ‘Get New e-PAN’.
Enter your Aadhaar number, accept the terms and enter the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile.
Your name, photo and date of birth come from Aadhaar. Check them and submit. Note the acknowledgement number.
The e-PAN PDF is usually ready within minutes. Download it from the same page with your Aadhaar number.
Want a plastic card? Apply or reprint through Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL for about ₹107. It arrives by post in 15–20 days.

tips: Having two PAN cards is illegal; surrender any extra one.
Link PAN with Aadhaar or it becomes inoperative.

voter-id.name: Voter ID (EPIC)
voter-id.eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 or above on the qualifying date. You can apply in advance at 17.
docs: Proof of age: birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet, Aadhaar or PAN
Proof of address: Aadhaar, bank passbook, utility bill or rent agreement

steps.t: Sign up on the Voters' Service Portal
steps.d: Register with your mobile number on the portal or the Voter Helpline app.
Choose ‘New registration for general electors (Form 6)’. Enter your details and the address where you live now.
Upload a clear photo and your age and address proofs. Submit and note the reference number.
A BLO may visit your home to confirm you live there. Keep original documents ready.
After approval you receive an SMS with your EPIC number. Download the e-EPIC from the portal right away.
The plastic card comes by Speed Post. Check that you appear in the electoral roll before election day.

tips: Moving house? Use Form 8 to shift your address, not a new Form 6.
Use the Voter Helpline app to check your polling booth.

ration-card.name: Ration Card
ration-card.issuer: Your State Food & Civil Supplies Department
ration-card.eligibility: Families as per state income rules. Priority / Antyodaya cards for low-income households.
docs: Income certificate (for priority or BPL cards)
Family photo and head-of-family bank details

steps.t: Open your state food department portal
steps.d: Each state runs its own ration card site. Find yours from the NFSA portal's state list.

steps.t: Fill the new ration card form
steps.d: Add the head of family (usually the eldest woman) and all members with their Aadhaar numbers.
Upload proofs, submit, and save the application number. Some states need you to submit at the Tehsil / Food office.
A food inspector checks your details and income, sometimes with a home visit.
Once approved, download the card or collect it from the office. Your fair price shop is assigned on it.

tips: One Nation One Ration Card lets you collect ration in any state.
Do your ration card eKYC at the fair price shop.

birth-certificate.name: Birth Certificate
birth-certificate.eligibility: Every birth in India must be registered. Late registration needs a fee and affidavit.
docs: Hospital discharge slip or birth report

steps.d: For hospital births, the hospital usually reports to the registrar. For home births, the family reports within 21 days.
Sign up as a general public user on the Civil Registration System portal, or visit your municipal / panchayat office.
Enter child's details (name can be added later), parents' details and place of birth.
The registrar checks the hospital record and documents.
Once approved, download the digitally signed certificate or collect it from the office.

tips: Register within 21 days. It is free and needs no affidavit.
Since October 2023 the birth certificate is accepted as proof of date of birth everywhere.

death-certificate.name: Death Certificate
death-certificate.eligibility: Family member or hospital reports the death within 21 days.
docs: Cremation or burial ground receipt (if no hospital)

steps.d: The hospital reports deaths that happen there. For deaths at home, a family member reports to the local registrar within 21 days.

steps.t: Apply on CRS or at the office
steps.d: Fill the death report form on the CRS portal or at the municipal / panchayat office.
The registrar checks the medical certificate and documents.
Download or collect several copies. Banks, insurers and property offices each ask for one.

tips: Ask for multiple certified copies at once.
You need it for insurance claims, pension and property transfer.

income-certificate.name: Income Certificate
income-certificate.eligibility: Residents of the state who need it for scholarships, fee waivers or welfare schemes.
docs: Salary slip, Form 16 or self-declaration of income

steps.d: Every state has one (for example e-District, Seva Sindhu, Aaple Sarkar). You can also go to a Common Service Centre (CSC).
Register, select the service and fill family income details.
Upload proofs and pay the small service fee. Save the application number.
Revenue officials verify income, sometimes with a local enquiry.
Download the digitally signed certificate from the portal or DigiLocker.

tips: Most income certificates are valid for one financial year.
Search ‘income certificate’ plus your state name on YouTube for state-specific steps.

caste-certificate.name: Caste Certificate
caste-certificate.eligibility: Members of SC, ST, OBC or other notified categories in your state.
docs: Father's or a blood relative's caste certificate
School leaving certificate showing caste (if any)
Income proof for OBC non-creamy layer

steps.t: Go to your state e-District portal or a CSC
steps.d: Choose the caste certificate service for your state.
Enter family details and the caste / sub-caste exactly as it appears in your family's records.
Upload relatives' caste certificates and other proofs, pay the fee, and save the reference number.
The revenue officer verifies records, sometimes with a local enquiry.
Download the signed certificate. Central jobs need the central-format OBC certificate, so ask for that format if needed.

tips: OBC-NCL certificates are usually renewed every year.
Keep relatives' certificates ready; they speed up approval.

domicile-certificate.name: Domicile Certificate
domicile-certificate.eligibility: Usually 3–15 years of residence in the state, depending on state rules.
docs: Proof of years of residence: school records, voter ID, property papers

steps.d: Or visit a Common Service Centre near you.
Fill in how long you have lived in the state and your address history.
Upload documents that show your years of residence, then pay the fee.
Revenue officials check the records.
Download it from the portal or DigiLocker.

tips: Needed for state quota admissions and state jobs.

marriage-certificate.name: Marriage Certificate
marriage-certificate.eligibility: Groom 21+, bride 18+. Special Marriage Act needs a 30-day notice period.

steps.d: Already married by religious rites? Register under your personal law (for example the Hindu Marriage Act). Inter-faith or court marriage? Use the Special Marriage Act.
Fill the marriage registration form online and book a date with the Sub-Registrar / SDM office.
A 30-day public notice is displayed. Objections, if any, are heard in this time.
Both partners and the witnesses sign before the registrar with original documents.
Under personal law it is often issued the same day. Download or collect the certificate.

tips: Needed for passport name change, visas and joint loans.

ayushman-card.name: Ayushman Card (PM-JAY)
ayushman-card.eligibility: Families listed in SECC data or state lists, and every citizen aged 70+ (Ayushman Vay Vandana).

steps.d: Open the beneficiary portal or the Ayushman app, log in with mobile OTP and search by state and Aadhaar.
Verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication and take a live photo in the app.
Your request goes to the state health agency. It is often approved within a day.
Download the Ayushman card from the app or portal. It covers up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.

tips: Show the card at the hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.
Cashless treatment; no payment at empanelled hospitals.

abha.name: ABHA Health ID
docs: Aadhaar (or driving licence) linked to mobile

steps.d: Click ‘Create ABHA Number’ and choose Aadhaar.
Enter Aadhaar, accept consent and enter the OTP.
Pick an address like yourname@abdm to share health records with doctors.
Download your ABHA card. Link it in apps like Aarogya Setu or DigiLocker to store reports.

tips: Different from the Ayushman card; ABHA stores records, it is not insurance.

e-shram.name: e-Shram Card
e-shram.eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16–59 who are not EPFO/ESIC members or income tax payers.

steps.d: Click ‘Register on e-Shram’, or visit a CSC if you don't have a phone linked to Aadhaar.
Enter your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and Aadhaar, then the OTP.
Add address, education, occupation, skills and bank account.
Get your 12-digit Universal Account Number card instantly.

tips: Gives ₹2 lakh accident insurance under PMSBY for registered workers.
